basis: Grouped country validation with year-matched crisis features
feature_upgrade: Added year-matched fiscal/external deterioration features and systemic-crisis recency memory.
smote_status: Available locally after imbalanced-learn 0.14.0 upgrade, but not used in the promoted classifier because class-weighted logistic validation performed better for precision.
notes: Precision improved materially versus the previous high-recall review setting, but the crisis classifier remains a weak-to-moderate early-warning overlay rather than a stand-alone decision model.
The production score continues to use the classifier as an upward-only capped overlay; the pillar score remains the main model signal.
Further improvement likely requires stronger banking-system stress time series and market-access/liquidity indicators, not only estimator tuning.
